title: Production of oxymethylene ethers (OME) as sustainable diesel fuel substitutes: continuous synthesis from dimethyl ether and trioxane and evaluation of catalyst stability
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,1941-1956
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00818A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Marius Drexler, Victor Zaghini Francesconi, Ulrich Arnold, Thomas A. Zevaco, Jörg Sauer
Within the study, synthesis of OME in a continuous, liquid phase process at the kg h−1 scale is demonstrated. Catalyst deactivation is observed and further investigated to understand the underlying mechanism and propose further developments.
